features.mechanism_target: the old IDF-weighted therapy-target mechanism match over graph chains
features.target_go: therapy target mechanism's GO term found in the candidate gene's propagated UniProt GO, x GO IDF
features.symptoms: IC-weighted Jaccard of curated HPO phenotypes (the old phenotype scorer)
features.phenotype_systems: cosine of IC-weighted HPO top-level organ-system profiles, system IDF over HPO diseases
features.gene_family: IDF-weighted cosine of PANTHER family + InterPro Family entries (gene-family membership)
features.protein_domains: IDF-weighted cosine of InterPro Domain/Repeat/Homologous-superfamily + Pfam (structure)
features.go_process: IDF-weighted cosine of UniProt GO biological-process terms, propagated over is_a/part_of
features.reactome: IDF-weighted cosine of Reactome pathways incl. ancestors (signalling / metabolic pathway)
features.compartment: IDF-weighted cosine of UniProt GO cellular-component terms, propagated
features.tissue: cosine of HPA enriched-tissue vectors, log1p(nTPM) x tissue IDF (0 for low-specificity genes)
features.mutation_type: 1 - Jensen-Shannon divergence of ClinVar P/LP spectra (truncating/missense/inframe/splice/CNV)
features.molecular_consequence: IDF-weighted cosine of mechanism classes (LoF/HI/DN/GoF/destabilization + G2P consequence)
features.shared_gene: 1 if the candidate's causal gene is a known disease's gene (degenerate here: one gene per disease)

design.outer_cv: leave-one-therapy-class-out (all cases of a class held out together)
design.grid: w in {0,1} per feature (12 features, 4095 settings), objective inner MRR, ties -> fewer features
design.logit: conditional logit, w >= 0, L2 lambda=1.0, projected gradient
excluded_from_tuning: shared_gene (constant 0: no two atlas diseases share a causal gene)
design.ci: 95% bootstrap over therapy classes, 2000 draws, seed 20261004
design.normalisation: each feature divided by its max over the query's candidates
